**Going out:** Instagram post, own account, Pebblebrook Tea Co.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Earl Grey uses real bergamot oil and a little cornflower" | Product fact (ingredients), fine as written |
| "Rated 4.9 out of 5 from over 5,000 reviews on our website" | Doesn't match policy. The approved claim is "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website" (export, October 2026). 4.9 and 5,000 are inflated, with no source in this chat. Treat as an invented stat. |

**Regulated claims:** nothing on health, money, environment, children or prices.

**House style:** Warm, plain and unhurried, with no banned words and no AI tells. Score about 92. No changes needed beyond the claim.

**Disclosure:** Own-account organic post, no partnership, affiliate link or gifted product. No label needed.

**Fixed (suggested):** Replace the rating line with the approved wording:
> Rainy Sunday, second pot. Our Earl Grey uses real bergamot oil and a little cornflower. Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website.

**Needs a decision:** If the review numbers really have moved to 4.9 and 5,000+, someone needs to supply a fresh export so the policy row can be updated. Until then, use the 4.8 / 1,200 wording.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). Not approved yet. Please ask Sam to approve the corrected text above, and nothing gets published until then.
